Campus Programming with MAC

I was involved in the Muhlenberg Activities Council (MAC), which planned and organized campus-wide events. I also served on the board as After Dark Events Coordinator.

This work connected with something I did across college life: making plans, communicating with people, and helping create opportunities to spend time together.

Events & Activities

MAC’s programming included social gatherings, themed events, trivia and bingo, movie nights, performances, trips, and other activities. I helped plan and support campus events through my involvement in the organization.

Working on these activities was a different scale of organizing from a single-interest club, with programming for the wider Muhlenberg community.
